_note: TASK-EV-PAY: the sim unit's serialized capability view (the 1089 m_Capabilities object a UNIT_CAPABILITIES report carries) for a unit whose stub_payload is configured with two bays, payload.bays [{key:left},{key:right}]. Feeds compile_op.js --caps so 'do payload.left|right' resolves against the advertised per-bay actions, and lands in the .ctx.json sidecars so verify_wrap.js checks waited-on facts (payload.left.released & co) against the same advert. The per-bay facts payload.<bay>.released are listed in the events map exactly like the gpio caps' per-pin entries: they are documented namespace facts even though the frozen advert names them in desc. ci/check_library.py parses this file strictly - keep it comment-free.

advert.desc: facts: payload.released {t,bay?} and payload.<bay>.released {t,src} once per release; the payload namespace has no command events
